name: Sliding Gate Operator SG1200
description: Heavy-duty sliding gate operator for wide industrial gates.

components.name: Drive Motor
components.maintenance: Verify duty cycle, voltage stability, and cooling clearance

components.name: Control Board
components.description: Industrial control PCB with dual safety inputs
components.function: Coordinates motor drive, remotes, and safety loops
components.failure: Input short or failed safety loop
components.maintenance: Test photocell and edge inputs monthly

components.name: Position Sensor
components.function: Provides precise travel feedback for soft-stop

components.name: Gearbox
components.function: Delivers high torque to the rack pinion
components.maintenance: Check seals and replace lubricant per schedule

components.name: Protective Cover
components.function: Shields drive unit from weather and impact
components.maintenance: Replace gaskets and verify drainage vents
